rationale: BABA gapped down nearly 6% at the open and is now sitting exactly at the midpoint of today's range with no clear directional momentum — the last five 1-minute candles show a tight, choppy consolidation between $94.67 and $94.78 with no breakout impulse in either direction. The 9-EMA ($94.77) is just above current price and VWAP ($94.58) is just below, compressing price into a neutral zone that offers no clean mechanical edge for a long or short entry. With 117 minutes remaining and the ATR small relative to the gap already absorbed, the risk/reward for initiating a position in either direction is insufficient to justify committing capital.
